summary: Increased Row Limit lets admins raise visualization row limits for maps, scatterplots, and tables up to 50,000 rows or datapoints.
extended_definition: Increased Row Limit lets admins raise visualization row limits for maps, scatterplots, and tables up to 50,000 rows or datapoints.

evidence_snippets: When enabled,the Increased Row Limit preview feature lets admins set row limits up to 50,000 rows or datapoints for map charts , scatterplot charts , and table charts .
Admins can set the limits for each visualization type in the Visualization limits setting on the Content guardrails admin page.

This feature allows admins to set limits on tiles per dashboard and per tab to optimize performance, which is configured on the Content Guardrails page in the Performance Center section of the Admin panel.

evidence_snippets: Visualization limits Note: This feature is available only when the Increased Row Limit preview feature is enabled.

You can send, schedule, or download a dashboard with increased row limits in PDF format , with the following caveats: The query results for each table chart on a dashboard will display up to 50,000 rows, to a maximum total limit of 200,000 cells per dashboard.
There are several things to know about Visualization limits : Existing dashboard tiles won't automatically reflect row limit increases.
